findings.text: The company was incorporated on 22 June 2004 and has been active for 22.3 years.
There are no insolvency records held for the company.
Accounts are not overdue, with the next due date being 31 December 2026, and the confirmation statement is not overdue, with the next due date being 10 July 2027.
One corporate controller, CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2111, holds between 75 and 100 percent of shares and voting rights, and has the right to appoint and remove directors.
There are three satisfied charges registered against the company, with no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.
The current officer list includes two directors, PERSON 555 and PERSON 556, and one other officer.
Director PERSON 556 has 49 other appointments, including 43 active and 6 dissolved companies, while director PERSON 555 has 9 other active appointments.
Since 24 October 2025, there has been one officer appointment and one resignation, involving the appointment of PERSON 555 and the resignation of PERSON 563.
